title: Sni Valley Fire Protection District — Sales tax and property-tax reduction

measureRecord.whatItDoes: Imposes a 1% sales tax to fund Sni Valley Fire Protection District operations. Each year, the district’s total property-tax levy would be reduced enough to lower property-tax revenue by an amount equal to 50% of the previous year’s revenue from this sales tax.
measureRecord.yesMeans: Approve the 1% sales tax and the linked annual property-tax reduction.
measureRecord.noMeans: Reject this proposed sales tax and linked property-tax reduction.

officialQuestion:
SNI VALLEY FIRE
          PROTECTION DISTRICT
               QUESTION
Shall Sni Valley Fire Protection District impose a sales
tax of one percent (1%) for the purpose of providing
revenues  for  the  operation  of  the  Sni  Valley  Fire
Protection District and the total property tax levy on
properties in the Sni Valley Fire Protection District shall
be reduced annually by an amount which reduces
property tax revenues by an amount equal to fifty percent
of the previous year's revenue collected from this sales
tax?
YES
NO
IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Jackson County Board of
scopeResolution: Exact district boundary/jurisdiction unresolved; do not assign county-wide.
